devicesHelp: Add a TV with "+", enter name and IP address (a fixed IP is recommended) and save. Then pair it once: switch the TV on, click "Start pairing", enter the code shown on the TV and click "Confirm code". No developer options or ADB are required.
Name: Name
enableImeTooltip: Needed for the state currentApp and for sending text. Disable it if the TV keeps showing 'Use keyboard on mobile device'.
appsHelp: Each entry creates a button <device>.apps.<name> for every TV. Use an https deep link (e.g. https://www.netflix.com/title). Package names are not accepted by every device (the NVIDIA SHIELD rejects them). Any app can also be started via the state launchApp.
clientNameHelp: Shown on the TV during pairing
reconnectMaxHelp: If a TV is unreachable (e.g. unplugged), the retry interval doubles from 2 s up to this value.
pairingHint: Pairing is only needed once per TV (again after a factory reset). The instance must be running; the code is valid for about one minute.
connRemoteAdb: Android TV Remote + ADB (media info, apps by package)
adbHint: Enable network debugging on the TV: SHIELD: Settings › Device Preferences › Developer options › Network debugging. Fire TV: Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options › ADB debugging. At the first connection the TV asks "Allow debugging?" – tick "Always allow" and confirm. Note: with ADB enabled, anyone in your network can control the device.
adbPollHelp: Only while the device is on; in standby no ADB traffic is generated (with Android TV Remote) or only the power state is queried (ADB only).
